title: loading-the-memories
description: Result structure for the loading-the-memories transformer. Signature: Set(MemoryCell) -> AutoMemoryMirror. Fires at Claude Code SessionStart; reads from <character>/doing/working/journaling/library/memory/library/<kind>/*.md and writes to ~/.claude/projects/<id>/memory/<kind>_<slug>.md, regenerating MEMORY.md.

loaded-count.description: Number of memory cells mirrored into the auto-memory directory.

auto-memory-dir.description: Absolute path to the populated Claude Code auto-memory directory.

in-repo-dir.description: Absolute path to the in-repo memory library that was read.
